constraints: Preserve the existing Neyam brand identity and real restaurant copy
Keep interactive targets at least 44px high
Maintain WCAG AA color contrast and visible focus
Keep the application compatible with Next.js static export
Avoid generic SaaS cards, glass-heavy styling, and decorative gradients

decisions.choice: Use a compact parchment-and-maroon mobile quick-action dock adapted from touch-friendly 21st mobile navigation patterns.
decisions.rationale: Keeps menu and directions reachable during the long editorial scroll without replacing the existing header.

decisions.choice: Retain the cinematic hero and dual CTAs while tightening type and vertical rhythm only on narrow, short screens.
decisions.rationale: Preserves the distinctive food footage while moving primary actions into reach on 320px-wide phones.
